description: A script that uses Redis CLI commands to generate a JSON representation of Redis commands and their metadata, transforming raw command data into a structured format.

methods.name: convert_flags_to_boolean_dict
methods.description: Converts a list of flags into a dictionary with each flag as a key set to True.

methods.name: set_if_not_none_or_empty
methods.description: Sets a key in a destination dictionary if the value is not None or an empty list.

methods.name: convert_argument
methods.description: Transforms an argument dictionary, converting flags and nested arguments.

methods.name: convert_keyspec
methods.description: Transforms a key specification dictionary, converting flags.

methods.name: convert_entry_to_objects_array
methods.description: Transforms Redis command JSON output into a structured, friendlier format, including subcommands and metadata.
